findings.title: Adception: malvertising another search engine's search results to redirect to a malicious page
findings.summary_md: Push Security's original disclosure by Luke Jennings documents a sponsored Google result for the query `claude mac` that displayed `bing.com` as its destination, then routed clicks through Bing's `bing.com/ck/a` click-tracking redirect and a compromised WordPress page on `homeopatiaalemana[.]com` before landing on the fake installer site `claude-desk-code[.]com`. The embedded timestamp in the Bing click link decodes to October 5, 2026, indicating the redirect chain was staged days before publication. The team links the campaign to a shared ClickFix toolkit it tracks as AcSig, seen across additional domains including `cli-desktop[.]com` and `lake-90[.]com`, and lists IoCs at the end of the post.
